mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS "records", count(DISTINCT x.tenancy_id) AS "contracts", count(DISTINCT x.tawtheeq_unit_id) AS "units", count(DISTINCT x.tenancy_id) FILTER (WHERE x.tenancy_status = 'ACTIVE') AS "activeContracts", round(coalesce(sum(x.rental_value_aed) FILTER (WHERE x.tenancy_status = 'ACTIVE'), 0), 0) AS "activeAnnualRent", round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x.rental_value_aed) FILTER (WHERE x.tenancy_status = 'ACTIVE' AND x.rental_value_aed > 0))::numeric, 0) AS "medianAnnualRent", round(sum(x.rental_value_aed) FILTER (WHERE x.rental_value_aed > 0 AND x.unit_area_sqm > 0) / nullif(sum(x.unit_area_sqm) FILTER (WHERE x.rental_value_aed > 0 AND x.unit_area_sqm > 0), 0), 0) AS "rentPerSqm", count(DISTINCT x.tenancy_id) FILTER (WHERE x.tenancy_status = 'ACTIVE' AND x.tenancy_end_date BETWEEN current_date AND current_date + 90) AS "expiring90", min(x.start_date) AS "firstStart", max(x.tenancy_end_date) AS "lastEnd" FROM theme.mkt_tenancy x WHERE true

SELECT coalesce(nullif(x.${dim}, ''), 'Unknown') AS "k", count(DISTINCT x.tenancy_id) AS "n", round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x.rental_value_aed) FILTER (WHERE x.rental_value_aed > 0))::numeric, 0) AS "medianRent" FROM theme.mkt_tenancy x WHERE true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT extract(year FROM x.start_date)::int AS "y", count(DISTINCT x.tenancy_id) AS "n", round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x.rental_value_aed) FILTER (WHERE x.rental_value_aed > 0))::numeric, 0) AS "medianRent" FROM theme.mkt_tenancy x WHERE x.start_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT x.contract_num AS "contractNum", x.unit_name AS "unitName", x.unit_type AS "unitType", x.property_name AS "propertyName", x.tenancy_status AS "status", x.start_date AS "startDate", x.tenancy_end_date AS "endDate", round(x.rental_value_aed, 0) AS "annualRent", x.unit_area_sqm AS "areaSqm", x.bedrooms AS "bedrooms" FROM theme.mkt_tenancy x WHERE true ORDER BY x.start_date DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM theme.mkt_sale x WHERE true ) AS "sales", (SELECT round(coalesce(sum(price_aed), 0), 0) FROM theme.mkt_sale x WHERE true ) AS "salesValue", (SELECT round(sum(price_aed) / nullif(sum(sold_area_sqm), 0), 0) FROM theme.mkt_sale x WHERE price_aed > 0 AND sold_area_sqm > 0 ) AS "salesRatePerSqm", (SELECT count(*) FROM theme.mkt_mortgage x WHERE true ) AS "mortgages", (SELECT round(coalesce(sum(amount_aed), 0), 0) FROM theme.mkt_mortgage x WHERE true ) AS "mortgagesValue", (SELECT count(*) FROM theme.mkt_rent x WHERE true ) AS "rents", (SELECT round(coalesce(sum(annual_value_aed), 0), 0) FROM theme.mkt_rent x WHERE true ) AS "rentsAnnualValue", (SELECT count(*) FROM theme.mkt_plot_transaction x WHERE true ) AS "plotTransactions"

SELECT to_char(m, 'YYYY-MM') AS "m", sum(s) AS "sales", sum(mo) AS "mortgages", sum(r) AS "rents" FROM ( SELECT date_trunc('month', contract_date) m, 1 s, 0 mo, 0 r FROM theme.mkt_sale x WHERE contract_date IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('month', start_date), 0, 1, 0 FROM theme.mkt_mortgage x WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('month', start_date), 0, 0, 1 FROM theme.mkt_rent x WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL ) u GROUP BY m ORDER BY m DESC LIMIT 12
